PILLAR 1: DELIVERY & EXECUTION EXCELLENCE Objective: Measures the operational discipline and predictability of program delivery across the AI Center of Excellence (CoE) portfolio, forming the foundation of stakeholder trust. Maturity Context: Delivery cadences, estimation models, and reporting templates are new. Foundation-phase targets prioritize accurate baselining over hitting mature benchmarks. PILLAR 2: AI SOLUTION DEVELOPMENT Objective: Measures technical throughput and engineering quality of AI solutions, from model performance to production reliability. Maturity Context: Development work started approximately 6 weeks ago. No solution has reached production yet, so Foundation-phase targets focus on establishing Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) foundations, governance, and the

so Foundation-phase targets focus on establishing Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) foundations, governance, and the first Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) before scaling delivery throughput. PILLAR 3: INNOVATION & TEAM LEADERSHIP Objective: Measures contribution to the CoE's innovation pipeline and the growth of team capability and stakeholder relationships. Maturity Context: With the newly formed team, early emphasis is on building the opportunity pipeline, completing the skills baseline, and establishing stakeholder trust. Conversion and engagement targets scale as relationships and PoC volume mature.

Definition A project is considered long-running if it remains open for 90 calendar days from the Project Start Date, defined as the date when the Asset Audit task was moved to “In Progress.” Guidance for Project Coordinators (PCs) PCs must regularly monitor projects that cross the 90-day open threshold.
